content.text:
Resubmitted with the minimality defect cured.

**What changed from the prior submission:** the declaratory sentence "This Agreement shall continue in full force and effect following a Change of Control of PB." is gone; p0766 is now simply struck (empty replacement), so the no-termination sentence in 14.2.6 alone carries that element.

**Final proposal (preferred level, five surgical edits):**
1. §15.6 — insert "not to be unreasonably withheld" into the mutual consent gate.
2. §15.6 — narrow the affiliate/successor carve-out from "either Party" to "PB", so SFJ may assign only with our consent.
3. §15.6 — competitor-assignment bar now applies "at any time" (Program Transfer sunset and its avoidance-of-doubt sentence removed).
4. §14.2.6 — caption conformed and SFJ's sole-discretion change-of-control termination right (plus the 150% Development Costs payment) replaced with "SFJ shall have no right to terminate this Agreement as a result of a Change of Control of PB."
5. §14.2.6 — the consequences paragraph, which turned solely on that deleted termination, struck to avoid a dangling "such termination" reference.

**Cross-reference check performed:** no provision outside p0765–p0766 cites Section 14.2.6; §14.3 and the survival list refer only to Articles/Sections 14.2 and 14.3 generally, so nothing dangles. PB's change-of-control notice duty, the 6.7.2 Buy-Out Option, and SFJ's limited-partner payment-assignment right are untouched.
